attr.begin: <q>Hey buddy, since you're standing around doing nothing useful, could you get me some, uh, pornography? The good kind. You've been around, you know what I'm talking about.</q> He rolls over and goes back to sleep.
attr.underway: WHERE'S MY PORN YOU STUPID ASSHOLE
attr.end: <q>Thanks for the porn, buddy.</q> The bum makes odd jerking motions from under the blanket, you wonder what that could be all about.

warnings.warning: Don't lose that gay porno! You may or may not need it for a quest?

attr.description: Bring the tiki mask guy a snack from the automat, item {shared:urinal_cake_quest:automat_code:%L%N}
attr.begin: <q>Listen mister, thanks for everything that you do. You should get a raise in pay, really. Get me a snack from the automat, my favorite treat is {shared:urinal_cake_quest:automat_code:%L%N}. Thanks. Thanks so much. So, so much.</q>
attr.underway: The bum seems mildly annoyed that you've come back without his afternoon snack. <q>The fuck is my-- okay, fine. From the top then: Get me a snack from the automat, my favorite treat is {shared:urinal_cake_quest:automat_code:%L%N}.</q>
attr.end: <q>Ah, great, glad these are still even in stock. Hurray and yay.</q> The bum rolls over and goes to sleep.

attr.description: Bring bottle of booze to the bum in the alley
attr.begin: <q>I have a present for the monster in the alley behind the porno shop: Booze! His favorite.</q> The creature hands you a shiny bottle of brown booze. <q>Please send this to him, compliments of myself. (That's me.)</q>
attr.restarted: Oh dear. You lost your booze. Here's more.
attr.underway: The bog creature sighs loudly. <q>Bring the booze to the tiki monster, chop chop!</q>
attr.end: <q>Thanks,</q> says the bum. He takes a swig and hugs the bottle.

conditions.fail_missing_required: The bum is angry: <q>What good is an empty bottle? You dumb fuck.</q>
conditions.success_with_optional: The bum sniffs the bottle warily. <q>Smells funny,</q> he says, <q>but whatever.</q> He seems happy either way.

warnings.warning: Uh oh, you drank the bum's booze. No good will come of this!

attr.description: Bring the bum something to eat
attr.begin: <q>Could you find me something to eat? I'm a picky eater. You'll help me, right? I'm just (rolls eyes) a helpless non-player character you know.</q>
attr.underway: Where's my food?
attr.end: The bum eats the foodstuff. <q>Thanks buddy.</q>

warnings.warning: Oh no, you ate the bum's {direct}. He was looking forward to a delicious meal.

attr.description: Feed My Pet Goat
attr.begin: <q>Listen, I have a goat problem I need to discuss: It's my darn goat - he's hungry and I ain't got nothing to feed him. And let me tell you, that goat is picky as hell. If you see him around here, give him some grub. And don't try to skimp out on him, he deserves the good stuff. I'm stuck here on the streets, can't move around much. That's where you come in, bud. Do me a favor and feed the damn goat, will ya? I don't want him keeling over on my watch.</q> Despite the bum's horrible smell you decide to help him out and feed his stupid goat.
attr.underway: <q>You were feeding my goat, remember? Do you remember that?</q>
attr.end: The goat seems happy to eat the tin can: <q>BAHHHHHHHHH</q>

attr.description: Bring a postcard to the beatnik
attr.begin: <q>Are you new here? Well, then!</q> From under his skirt, the creature produces a postcard and hands it to you. <q>I need this delivered to that dirty beatnik right away!</q> He pauses for emphasis. <q>Right! Away! Now go. Scoot. I've got a lot of work to do around the bog.</q> The creature flops back down on the ground and makes shooing gestures. <q>Scram!</q>
attr.restarted: Did you lose your postcard? Here's another.
attr.underway: The bog creature seems annoyed. <q>Go deliver the postcard! GEEZE</q>
attr.end: The beatnik crumples up the postcard without reading it. <q>I care a lot about things.</q>

attr.description: Bring a note back to the bog creature
attr.begin: <q>What does that idiot want now?</q> The beatnik produces a pen and a notepad, writes a reply and hands you a note. <q>Give this to him.</q>
attr.restarted: <q>Did you lose the note?</q> Again, he produces a pen and a notepad, writes a reply and hands you the note. <q>Give this to him for real this time.</q>
attr.underway: Did you deliver the note? Go do the thing!
attr.end: The bog creature reads the note carefully. <q>Well, then!</q>

attr.description: Visit the church
attr.begin: The bog creature lowers his voice and leans in: <q>Go to the church. Get some religion. It's good for you.</q>
attr.underway: The bog creature ignores you.
attr.end: You have found the church! All you need to do now is pray.

attr.description: Play a song for the bog creature
attr.begin: <q>Could you play me a song? I demand you entertain me!</q> He pauses then says: <q>Good luck finding a musical instrument!</q>
attr.restarted: Remember when I asked you to play me a song? Need you to do that.
attr.underway: Remember when I asked you to play me a song? Still need you to do that.
attr.end: Toot! The bog creature claps his hands together excitedly. <q>Bravo!</q>

attr.description: Pick up the bog monster's dinner from the restaurant
attr.underway: <q>Where's my dinner?</q>
attr.dress_code_violation: The waiter is furious at your presence: <q>What are you doing in my dining room? You are the local idiot who runs around doing favors for bog monsters and homeless bums and rude beatniks! There's *no way* you could afford to eat here. This so-called receipt is some kind of scam. Begone from this establishment!</q> The waiter refuses to acknowledge you any further.
attr.restarted: <q>Did you lose my dinner receipt?</q> The bog monster magically produces an identical copy and hands it over. <q>Ain't adventure game logic fun? Anyway, get me my dinner.</q>
attr.begin: <q>Thank you for that lovely song and dance.</q> The bog monster continues: <q>Now, if you wouldn't mind, pick up my dinner. Here's a receipt, give it to the waiter. Go, go!</q>
attr.end: The waiter suddenly pivots towards you: <q>Ah, monsieur, it is always good to see new faces.</q> He goes to the kitchen and returns with a fish. <q>Your dinner! Bon appetit!</q> He hands you the fish.

attr.description: Deliver the bog monster's dinner
attr.restarted: <q>Sacre bleu, you have lost the dinner.</q> He produces another red herring and hands it over. <q>Don't lose it this time.</q>
attr.begin: <q>Enjoy your meal!</q>
attr.end: <q>Mmm, food.</q> You have pleased the bog monster.

warnings.warning: You ate the bog monster's dinner! He might eat YOU for dinner now!

attr.description: Bring the beatnik a cappuccino
attr.begin: The beatnik says, <q>Well, that was quite an adventure. Could you get me a cappuccino? You know what that is, right?</q>
attr.underway: The beatnik says, <q>Uh, where's my cappuccino?</q>
attr.end: The beatnik says, <q>Mmm. Thanks. Come back later, I have more exciting shit for you to do.</q>

conditions.fail_missing_required: The beatnik makes a face: <q>Why would I want an empty cup?</q>
conditions.success_with_optional: The beatnik seems especially pleased with his drink: <q>Don't even tell me what the secret ingredient is, I love it!</q> The beatnik enthusiastically takes another sip.
conditions.fail_missing_all_required: The beatnik screams at you: <q>What the fuck is this? Don't you know what a cappuccino is? Get some foam in there you idiot!</q>

warnings.warning: Oh no, you drank the beatnik's coffee. You needed that for a quest!

attr.description: Bring the bat back home
attr.begin: You are inspired by the call to action and commit yourself to bat rescue.
attr.end: The bat is home! He flaps up to the top of the cave. You can't see him but you can hear him making content little bat noises.

warnings.warning: Don't drop that bat chow! Otherwise the bat will stop following you.

attr.description: Slay the monster!
attr.begin: You must slay the monster that lives in the dungeon.
attr.end: The snake wobbles back and forth, reeling from the blow. The speakerbox crackles to life: <q>Yo#u have defeate-e-e-e-e-d the# monster. Well xdone~.8 Proceed -t8o south --for your grea!t pleasure.</q>

attr.description: You must solve the maze!
attr.begin: Beware the dangers inside the maze while solving it or whatever.
attr.end: Wow, you did it, you solved the maze! Nice work, champ!

attr.description: Bring the beatnik a souvenir
attr.ineligible: The beatnik blinks hard. <q>I've got nothing else for you right now, maybe check back after you've worked with some of the others.</q>
attr.begin: The beatnik says, <q>Here's a ticket to the BoneQuest theme park, whatever that is. Bring me back a souvenir, okay? Something cool.</q>
attr.restarted: The beatnik looks confused. <q>Did you lose your ticket? Here's another ticket, dummy.</q>
attr.underway: The beatnik says, <q>So, where's my souvenir?</q>
attr.end: The beatnik says, <q>Love it, love everything about it. Thanks, dummy. Oh, by the way, you won the game. Congratulations, you're a fucking idiot. Go do something useful now.</q>

assets.announce_prefix: A bored-sounding voice says over the speakerbox:

complaints: Impatience drips from the troll's every word as it glowers down at you: <q>Hurry up!</q> Its patience has worn thin, and it's clear that your hesitance is irritating the foul creature. <q>Let's do this!</q> it barks, its voice echoing through the room. The troll's bulging muscles ripple beneath its mottled skin, and its beady eyes narrow into slits as it glares menacingly at you. Time is running out, and the troll is growing increasingly agitated by your every delay.

The troll's temper flares with each passing moment, its impatience reaching a boiling point. Its beady eyes burn with fury as it towers over you, and its voice echoes off the walls in a thunderous roar. <q>Enough with your delays!</q> the troll snarls, its massive fists clenched at its sides.

The troll clears his throat and fixes a cold, steely gaze upon you, making your heart skip a beat. You can feel the weight of its stare as it towers over you, its massive frame seeming to fill the entire room. <q>Your procrastination grows tiresome,</q> the troll growls, its voice low and menacing. <q>I grow impatient with each passing moment.</q>
The troll is ready and waiting.
You know what you have to do.

The troll enters the room. He seems upset.

The troll sighs and gives up troubleshooting the clogged toilet. He leaves the room, defeated.
The troll enters the room. He seems upset.
The troll uses the phone to dial a number: <q>Yeah, hi. It's me. It happened again. Yup, totally clogged. All right, thanks.</q>
The janitor is here. He is a funny-looking little fellow, a small man with a face that reminds you of a gerbil. He immediately gets to work on the clogged toilet.
The troll bellows: <q>Have you unclogged the toilet yet?</q>
